verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say it lets developers create deposit and wallet accounts held in FBO structures, covering customer wallets and sub-accounts. That maps to per-customer accounts and sub-accounts under a master (FBO) structure. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly says unique account and routing numbers are issued per account, describes virtual accounts for reconciliation, or shows provisioning at scale via API. missing for 10: explicit issuance of unique account/routing numbers, virtual accounts for reconciliation, documented at-scale API provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue unique account and routing numbers at scale — virtual accounts for reconciliation, per-customer collection accounts, and sub-accounts under a master structure

citations.quote: Create deposit accounts and wallet accounts held in FBO structures. Support use cases including operating accounts, customer wallets, sub-accounts, and multi-party fund flows
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components
Help your customers store and move money on your platform
